inputs.text: We are watching yet another clear illustration of how ruling elites use the machinery of the state to crush the working class and marginalized communities, reinforcing systemic oppression to protect their own power. Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala laid this bare at a press conference by calling for the total rejection of these proposed constitutional amendments. Let's be entirely clear: this is transparently aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. When those at the top manipulate the foundational laws of the land just to cling to power, it represents a profound structural assault on democratic accountability and institutional integrity. Sikhala heavily criticised what he described as [...] as he took aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3. This is entirely about entrenching authoritarian governance at the direct expense of ordinary people. We have to confront these structural causes head-on and stand in absolute solidarity with everyone resisting this top-down exploitation.
